scientific_question: Does v39's ~0.00714-bit confluence-priority benefit persist across many response-blind random site placements on exactly the same source landscapes, and how much apparent superiority is simply placement-seed variation?

design.comparison_stratum: v39 fixed 88 occupancy-ambiguous designs with >=3 static confluence sites; SAME 88 scenarios for every seed and every selection policy
design.seed_ids: 000 through 063 inclusive (64 deterministic independent SHA256 rankings); no seed is discarded
design.source_worlds: frozen v23 384 landscapes crossed with clustered/dispersed source geometries and three history schedules; no new ecological response
design.placement: for each seed and design: SHA256(seed+'|'+design_key+'|'+node_id), ascending hex digest then node_id; select first 3 among ALL non-source equilibrium-reachable nodes
design.baseline: v39 confluence-targeted: static graph possible-source count>=2 sorted descending count then node_id; choose first 3; never use history-specific source tags to pick sites
design.noninformative_coverage_control: count selected static confluence sites that do not vary across three histories post hoc, but never select using their truth-specific provenance tags
design.information_bits: exact v39 bayes_information I(activation history; noisy provenance tags | all four snapshots), with uniform prior over histories, no Monte Carlo observational outcomes
design.bayes_accuracy: v39 baseline-subtracted expected posterior correct-history probability

sensitivity_setting.role: optional separate perfect-tag upper diagnostics ONLY, not a replacement for q=.6/e=.1

estimands.PRIMARY_mean_confluence_minus_seed_ensem: mean over the fixed 88 ecological designs of confluence bits minus mean over 64 seed-specific random bits on SAME designs
estimands.secondary_seed_level_advantage: for each of 64 random placement seeds, difference between fixed target 88-world mean and random 88-world mean; summarize min/median/max/q10/q90 and fraction advantage > 0 (as descriptive)
estimands.secondary_world_level_advantage: for each world, target information minus 64-seed mean random information; report positive/tie/negative counts using numerical 1e-9 tolerance
estimands.geometry_modification: repeat same matched comparisons by clustered vs dispersed among the fixed 88 fair worlds, if either group has observations
estimands.posthoc_structural_mechanism: for each selected site count tags that are history-invariant even though node has 2+ potentially reaching sources; this is a DIAGNOSTIC, not a site-selection feature or causal measured trait
estimands.optional_perfect_control: compare target and multi-seed random at q=1,e=0 on the same 88 worlds; not primary

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: mean confluence minus 64-seed response-blind random ensemble >+0.020000000 bits at q=.6,e=.1 on exactly 88 fair v39-aliased worlds
at least 48 of 64 random seeds (>=75%) have lower 88-world mean information than fixed confluence policy
strictly more than half of the 88 fair worlds have fixed confluence information exceeding their own 64-seed random mean by >1e-9
falsifiable_hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED if positive-world count >44 else REFUTED

falsifiable_hypotheses.prediction: 64 random placement seeds yield at least two distinct 88-world mean-information values beyond numerical 1e-9
at least one selected fixed confluence site is provably history-invariant across all three v23 activation histories despite being reachable from >=2 potential graph sources
falsifiable_hypotheses.verdict: SUPPORTED if positive count>0 else REFUTED

negative_controls: exact previous 768/579/687 and 189/88 parent counts remain unchanged
v39 frozen SHA256 and predeclared fixed-one-seed 0.6558164099798183,0.648676018353758 values reconcile exactly within 1e-9
no newly read biological bird/genotype data, no exact historical route claim
